Definition: to inhale eagerly; figuratively, to cover; by implication, to be angry; also to hasten
BiblicalUsage: Sha'aph is panting, gasping after, and Amos turns it on the rich: they pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek. And they swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe panting after the poor is the picture of greed with its mouth open — the rich gasp for the dust on the poor man's head, and God hears it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
